message: Running command: cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/flac && git show 946c25de && echo "=====" && git show 22fffdce

message.content:
These are about the fuzzer infrastructure, not the actual vulnerability fix. Let me look at the actual issue. The issue 42529733 is a use-of-uninitialized-value in fuzzer_tool_flac. Let me look at the commits after HEAD that touch decode.c and could fix this. Let me look at the commit "946c25de Check for overflow when converting skip and until to samples" and "22fffdce Check for overflow when multiplying skip samples with sample size".

Let me look at the commit "d4daa861" more carefully - it's for issue 58277 which is a use-of-uninitialized-value. Let me look at what the actual issue 42529733 might be. Let me look at the git log for commits that mention "uninitialized" in the flac tool.

Let me look at the commit "c7861aa8 Also apply shift to raw data" and "946c25de".
